A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 15-page TYP paper, including Appendices A–G. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original generation and collaborative-perception experiments on OPV2V, V2V4Real, and ColWaymo, including ablations and additional experiments in Appendices C–E.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experimental results, including the main benchmark comparisons and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same two-stage conditional diffusion method, VQ-VAE representations, control module, domain adaptation, and target-domain enhancement procedures.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation coverage remains identical across OPV2V, Waymo/ColWaymo, and V2V4Real, including scene-editing examples and appendix scenarios.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same No Fusion, Early Fusion, Late Fusion, AttFuse, and V2X-ViT comparisons, together with identical oracle and pretraining controls.

E3.justification: Data splits, training budgets, pretraining and fine-tuning settings, AP0.5 distance ranges, and generation-quality metrics are unchanged throughout Section 4 and the appendices.

E4.justification: The adaptation ablation in Table 4, training-stage comparisons in Table 5 and Appendix E, limited-label study in Appendix C, and qualitative analyses are identical.

E5.justification: Both versions already specify three total runs in Appendix D and report means with standard deviations in Table 8. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results in Tables 1–5 and 7–8 and all qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains overall AP0.5 of 0.46 for TYP-generated data versus 0.49 for oracle data with Early Fusion.

T1.justification: The problem definitions, assumptions, representations, and mathematical objectives in Section 3, including Equations 1–10, are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about viewpoint-conditioned generation, the TYP solution, and scaling collaborative perception with little or no real collaborative training data.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning realism, transferability, and reduced data-collection needs remain unchanged. Section 5 and Appendix G retain the same vehicle-focused scope and proposed extensions.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 retains identical voxelization, model dimensions, batch sizes, epoch counts, hardware, 200-step DDIM inference, and post-processing details. No reproducibility or access information changes.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix A, and the reference list are unchanged, including positioning relative to 3D generation, diffusion models, domain adaptation, and NeRF.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v1 dated 10 Feb 2025 to v2 dated 1 Apr 2025. The prose, headings, terminology, section order, and appendix organization are identical.

P2.justification: All eight figures and eight tables retain identical displays, captions, placement, and layout. Pages 2–15 are pixel-identical; page 1 differs only in the existing version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: The later PDF updates the version/date stamp and document metadata while preserving the scientific content, evidence, exposition, and appendices. These administrative changes produce no meaningful gain or loss in overall paper quality.
